verdict.rationale: Highnote documents configurable webhooks (highnote-docs-12), signed payloads (highnote-docs-13), an integrated real-time ledger (highnote-docs-3, highnote-docs-19, highnote-docs-33), and a programmatic refund/dispute lifecycle (highnote-docs-20, highnote-docs-10, highnote-docs-31), suggesting post-auth events like refunds and chargebacks are trackable via API/webhooks. However, there is no explicit documentation enumerating clearing, reversal, or chargeback webhook event types, nor confirmation of stable transaction identifiers tying auth to post-auth events. Missing for 10: explicit list of post-auth webhook event types (clearing/reversal/chargeback), documentation of stable transaction ID linkage across the lifecycle, and independent confirmation the ledger stays in sync via these events.
